mapper.insert: insert into ai_video_generation_task (project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, priority, idempotency_key, provider_code, model_code, progress, max_retry, request_json, create_by, create_time) values (#{projectId}, #{chapterId}, #{assetId}, #{taskType}, #{taskName}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{providerCode}, #{modelCode}, #{progress}, #{maxRetry}, #{requestJson}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.select: select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress from ai_video_generation_task where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress, error_code, error_message, create_time from ai_video_generation_task where asset_id = #{assetId} and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) order by task_id desc limit 1

select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress, request_json, error_code, error_message, create_time from ai_video_generation_task where asset_id = #{assetId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = 'wanx' and status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) order by task_id desc limit 1 for update

select count(1) from ai_video_generation_task where asset_id = #{assetId} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) and status in ('PENDING', 'QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_CALLBACK', 'QUALITY_CHECK', 'RETRYING', 'NEEDS_REVIEW', 'SUBMITTED', 'PROCESSING', 'VALIDATING')
mapper.update:
update ai_video_generation_task
status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_time = now(), completed_time = now(), update_time = now()
where task_id = #{taskId} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'RUNNING', progress = 10, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = coalesce(started_time, now()), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'STORY_BIBLE' and status = 'QUEUED' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)
update ai_video_generation_task set provider_task_id = #{providerTaskId}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set provider_task_id = #{providerTaskId}, status = 'WAITING_CALLBACK', progress = 20, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = coalesce(started_time, now()), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = 'wanx' and status = 'QUEUED' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set provider_task_id = #{providerTaskId}, status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW', progress = 20, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = 'wanx' and status in ('QUEUED', 'NEEDS_REVIEW') and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'RUNNING', progress = 30, error_code = null, error_message = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = 'wanx' and status = 'WAITING_CALLBACK' and provider_task_id is not null and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task
status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage},
completed_time = now(),
update_time = now()
where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = 'wanx' and status = 'RUNNING' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW', progress = 20, error_code = 'WANX_VIDEO_SUBMISSION_INTERRUPTED', error_message = '本地进程在确认 Wanx 任务ID前中断，请勿重复提交，需人工核对', update_time = now() where task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = 'wanx' and status = 'QUEUED' and provider_task_id is null and coalesce(update_time, create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval 2 minute) and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'WAITING_CALLBACK', progress = 20, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = coalesce(started_time, now()), update_time = now() where task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = 'wanx' and status = 'QUEUED' and provider_task_id is not null and coalesce(update_time, create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval 2 minute) and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'WAITING_CALLBACK', progress = 30, error_code = 'WANX_VIDEO_POLL_INTERRUPTED', error_message = '上次轮询处理中断，已安全恢复等待状态', update_time = now() where task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = 'wanx' and status = 'RUNNING' and provider_task_id is not null and coalesce(update_time, create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute) and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'FAILED', progress = 100, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_time = now(), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = 'wanx' and status = 'QUEUED' and provider_task_id is null and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set provider_task_id = #{providerTaskId}, status = 'WAITING_CALLBACK', progress = 20, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = coalesce(started_time, now()), request_json = json_set(coalesce(request_json, json_object()), '$.resolution', json_object( 'action', 'RESUME_WITH_PROVIDER_TASK_ID', 'resolvedBy', #{resolvedBy}, 'resolvedAt', date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s'))), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = 'wanx' and status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'FAILED', progress = 100, error_code = 'WANX_VIDEO_CONFIRMED_NOT_SUBMITTED', error_message = '人工核对确认 Wanx 未受理，视频草稿已解锁', request_json = json_set(coalesce(request_json, json_object()), '$.resolution', json_object( 'action', 'CONFIRM_NOT_SUBMITTED', 'resolvedBy', #{resolvedBy}, 'resolvedAt', date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s'))), completed_time = now(), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = 'wanx' and status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW' and provider_task_id is null and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set request_json = #{requestJson}, model_code = #{modelCode}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and status = 'RUNNING' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'QUEUED', provider_task_id = null, progress = 5, model_code = #{modelCode}, request_json = #{requestJson}, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = null, completed_time = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and status = 'FAILED' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'RUNNING', progress = 10, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = now(), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and json_unquote(json_extract(request_json, '$.trigger')) = 'USER_CONFIRMED' and status = #{expectedStatus} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)
and coalesce(update_time, create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'FAILED', progress = 100, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_time = now(), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and status = #{expectedStatus} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)
mapper.select: select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress, request_json from ai_video_generation_task where (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and ( status = 'QUEUED' or (status = 'RETRYING' and coalesce(update_time, create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval 60 second)) or (status = 'RUNNING' and coalesce(update_time, create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute)) ) order by create_time asc limit 20

select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress from ai_video_generation_task where (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = 'wanx' and status = 'WAITING_CALLBACK' and provider_task_id is not null order by create_time asc limit 10

select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress, error_code, error_message, create_time from ai_video_generation_task where project_id = #{projectId} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) order by task_id desc
